events.title: Wildegrove Demo 0.3
events.summary: Wildegrove 0.3 Update NotesNew Enemies & Bosses:We added many new enemies to Wildegrove! You can now encounter various types of goblins, new skeletons and new types of mages!You can now fight 2 different bosses at waves 5 and 10! These bosses are spawned with an arena of their own, and pose a threat to the Keeper.New BalancingWe re-balanced all the waves in the game to better fit the new enemies and the player experience.
